name: Ramp
tagline: Ramp is a corporate spend management platform that automates expense reporting, vendor negotiations, and budget tracking with AI that identifies savings opportunities proactively — flagging duplicate subscriptions, negotiating better SaaS contracts, and alerting finance teams to unusual spending patterns. Unlike traditional expense tools, Ramp is built to reduce company spend rather than just track it. Fast-growing companies use Ramp to maintain financial discipline as headcount scales.
